name: novel-studio
description: Run and resume a whole novel project: organize the Story Bible, create native story objects, keep the Ledger and Canon, and pace autonomous work across phases.
procedure: Orient from the Project compass and the Ledger; follow its Next action unless redirected.
Create the Story Bible folder, Ledger, and Canon before multi-step work.
Load the phase's craft skill, then persist results as native objects and docs, never as chat.
Update the Ledger (Now, Next action, Notes to future self) after each unit of work.
Report briefly: what exists now, the next action, and only the author's genuine decisions.
